scope: Meaning-preserving display compression for the 15 communication-window rows that exceed three lines after tag-safe reflow.

review.source: Japanese read directly from original ISO using dialogue_index.json offsets; reviewed existing full English drafts and two adjacent rows on either side.
checks: All original tags preserved in exact sequence against index commands.
All 15 rows fit three lines at 460 font units; book/color spans do not split.
Locked linked terms and names retained.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Only residue from those life-forms was
in the cockpits. It had apparently
seeped into the electronics and parts.
rows.notes: Keeps the cockpit residue, infiltration into electronics/parts, and reported uncertainty. Compresses the full reviewed draft without removing its conclusion.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Cmdr. <color(4)>Misumaru<ce()> reports finding a
possible link to this incident. It is still
only a theory.
rows.notes: Abbreviates Commander to Cmdr.; retains the reported discovery, possible connection, and hypothesis status.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Reportedly, an abandoned test site
called the <book(1)>Baldora Drive<endbook()>. We're heading
there at once.
rows.notes: Compresses experimental facility to test site and retains hearsay and immediate departure. Locked Baldora Drive spelling retained.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>"<color(4)>Barrel Orland<ce()>. As of today, under
wartime special provisions, you are
appointed a 2nd Lt. in <book(10)>Londo Bell<endbook()>."
rows.notes: Retains effective today, special wartime provisions, appointment as second lieutenant, Barrel Orland, and linked Londo Bell. Abbreviates rank to 2nd Lt.; Londo Bell is visible on line 3.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Those were <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> troops. The
<book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> rules this Earth by
military force.
rows.notes: Retains both New Federation links, identity of the earlier troops, and military rule over this Earth; avoids adding a subject for the earlier fighting.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The One Year War was fought between
<book(9)>Earth Federation<endbook()> forces and the
<color(5)>Zeon Army<ce()>.
rows.notes: Retains the historical One Year War and both opposing forces. Removes only redundant wording that it was a war.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The unit from the recent <book(25)>Shirahime<endbook()>
attack was reportedly seen at other
colonies too.
rows.notes: Retains the recent Shirahime attack, same unit, other colonies, and report qualification.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>In the last war, the <book(42)>Space Rev. Army<endbook()>
used a colony drop as its trump card to
demand Earth's surrender.
rows.notes: Retains the last war, colony-drop trump card, and demand for Earth's surrender. Locked Space Rev. Army abbreviation retained.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Vast reserves of <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()> are
reported in a newly sighted
<book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>. <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> may appear there.
rows.notes: Retains the newly appeared Shin Dragon, vast Getter Rays reserves, report qualification, and possibility of Berkt appearing there.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Since then, my body glows faintly when
my emotions run high. Like a comic,
right?
rows.notes: Preserves onset after the previous line's experiments, emotional trigger, bodily glow, and comic comparison. Restores the source's faint glow nuance.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()> stayed a mystery, absent
from the <book(78)>Ageha Plan<endbook()>, because Dr.
<color(5)>Saotome<ce()> withdrew...
rows.notes: Retains the Invaders' absence from the Ageha Plan, their mystery, and Saotome's withdrawal as its cause.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The <book(69)>Scub Coral<endbook()> lies dormant, so it stays
below the <book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()>... That
was my theory.
rows.notes: Retains the speaker's hypothesis: dormancy is why Scub Coral has not crossed the Limit of Questions.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>The <book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()> began then. But
the <book(69)>Scub<endbook()> quickly went dormant to stop
it.
rows.notes: Retains the onset and emergency return to dormancy. The following line explains that prevention was incomplete, leaving a residual affected space; no claim of complete prevention is added.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Thanks to <book(46)>D.O.M.E.<endbook()>, the
<book(80)>Command Cluster<endbook()> canceled its <book(69)>Scub<endbook()> wake
order. Our trip paid off.
rows.notes: Retains D.O.M.E.'s causal role, the Command Cluster's cancellation of the Scub awakening order, and the value of coming here. Wake order abbreviates order to end dormancy.

rows.target:
<on()><sp(20)>Despite all the plan's preparations, the
<book(77)>Limit of Questions<endbook()> hasn't happened...
Why?
rows.notes: Retains the contradiction between extensive preparation and the Limit of Questions not occurring, plus the question asking why.

uncertainties.note: The source says the event began and was then prevented. The next line explicitly says prevention was incomplete. The shortened display text preserves this sequence; it should not be paraphrased to imply the event never began.
